name: design-md
description: Turn any public website into a DESIGN.md: its colors, typography, spacing and components as a markdown spec coding agents can build from.

interface.shortDescription: Get any website's design system as a DESIGN.md
interface.longDescription: Give ChatGPT a website URL and get back a DESIGN.md: the site's colors, typography, spacing, components and tone, written as a markdown spec. Hand it to a coding agent and the UI it builds matches the brand. A library of ready-made DESIGN.md files covers well-known sites like Linear, Stripe, Notion and Apple. Made by Sokosumi.
defaultPrompt: Build a landing page in Stripe's design style
Restyle this component to match our website's brand
